questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangerous conditions ahead. You might see warnings about changes in traffic direction, steep hills, or other hazards that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a road where traffic travels in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand signals since their bikes don't have turn signals. When a bicyclist holds their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs show that something is not allowed. This sign means you are going the wrong way and should turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and slowly in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction zones. Slow down and be careful in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must travel. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers near schools to slow down and watch for children in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate you are in or approaching a school zone. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: Round signs mean a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the lane ahead will end. Drivers in that lane need to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: Watch and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle shows it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows where people cross the road. Watch for pedestrians in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crosswalk where people cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yield sign is coming up. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead.
